evidence.quote: The first important item on the reform agenda is to extend the perimeter of regulation so that any firm whose failure could have serious systemic consequences will be subject to consolidated supervision, including minimum capital and liquidity requirements.
The SCAP clearly helped to restore public confidence in the banking system.
Another approach is to attack the bigness problem head-on by limiting the size of financial institutions.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses financial regulatory reform, the origins of the crisis, and supervision of large banks, not monetary policy. It takes no view on rates, inflation, activity or the balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
